reviewNotes: Reviewed every exported key against all 40 cards in data/pages72.json, vocabulary/furigana and context. Corrected three explanation inputs that truncated 霜降り to ふり; use しもふり matching the vocabulary and other occurrences. Preserve explicit source readings 肉汁 にくじる and にくじゅう with distinct lookup keys. Reviewed topic は→わ, directional へ→え and object を→お in context; 歯へ is はえ, preserving lexical 歯 は. Preserved はごたえ, はなす, はいり, はいった, はいっています, はったつ, はやく, はんい, へんか and へる. Katakana loanwords converted to hiragana retaining long vowels and small kana. A/B read えー/びー; page 72 read ななじゅうに; pair/sequence separators become pauses. Sentences, questions, explanations, polite complete answers, long answer clauses and procedural sequences use Nova generation speed 1.0; vocabulary and very short phrase/choice fragments use 0.85. Display text and lookup keys preserved. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
